items.title: Meta Brings Code Review Auto-Approval More Mainstream with PyTorch GreenLight
items.summary: PyTorch now lets an AI reviewer approve pull requests from its own maintainers. GreenLight is an open-source take on RADAR, the system Meta uses to auto-land low-risk diffs after safety checks, a risk score and an LLM review. OpenAI, Anthropic and Sonar describe similar ways to automate approval while keeping humans on risky changes. By Andrew Hoblitzell
items.zh: PyTorch用AI审阅者自动批准维护者PR，GreenLight开源复刻Meta内部RADAR，靠风险评分加LLM审查放行低风险改动
items.why: 可参考其风险评分与LLM审查的落地方式

items.title: datasette-charts 0.4a0
items.summary:
Release: datasette-charts 0.4a0 
 The new datasette-charts plugin has its own plugin hook to allow other plugins to define new chart types, but I hadn't actually used it for anything yet. I had Claude Opus 5.5 build an experimental plugins just to try out the hook and it came up with a bunch of friction points in the design. This release addresses those, which should make building additional chart plugins a whole lot more ergonomic. 
 I've also added a website for the plugin, at charts.datasette.io . The new website includes a tutorial for plugin authors , and a gallery showing all of the core charts and annotations, each one linking to an interactive demo on Datasette Lite . 
 
 
 
 Tags: datasette-charts , datasette , visualization , datasette-lite
items.zh: 新增插件钩子让其他插件定义图表类型，作者用Claude Opus 5.5试写插件后修复了设计摩擦点
items.why: 展示用LLM试跑插件钩子设计的实践

items.title: Azure AI Gateway Reaches General Availability as a Standalone Service
items.summary: Microsoft has made Azure AI Gateway generally available as a standalone Azure service for governing access to AI models and MCP tools across providers. A free tier covers 10,000 requests per gateway per month; paid billing starts January 1, 2027; and private networking remains in preview. By Steef-Jan Wiggers
